findings.title: Severity matrix applied correctly to port collisions
findings.body: Formula reserved-port collisions are safely neutralized to WARN if explicit configured envrc overrides do not collide. Configured collisions remain FAIL.

findings.title: Compose placeholder correctly isolated
findings.body: The DOPECON_BRIDGE_TOKEN dummy placeholder allows compose parse but is excluded from runtime mcp.env generation. Explicit task-orchestrator start strictly requires a real token.

findings.title: Foreign compose parsing hazard bypassed
findings.body: Foreign compose.yml files are properly ignored by doctor when --repo specifies a different path, preventing false alarms.
